guidance.applicabilityReason: Reviewed selection for a subsequent calibration-authoring task exercising RatingDescriptor.convert at this exact source cut: preserve original field initialization, consume frozen scenario attributes, and expose explicit decorator/dependency seams. This is not permission to reuse old captures, alter task scoring, apply calibration guidance to unrelated semantic analysis, or claim Harmony qualification or learning benefit.

qualification.boundary: reviewed interpretation of independently reconstructed source-suite controls

skill.body: Calibrate RatingDescriptor.convert against the exact frozen source under declared controlled defaults and an identity Observed decorator. Construct a fresh instance for each scenario and assert rating=0, indicator=false, stars=5, stepSize=0.5 and starStyle=false from actual own fields before convert. Read attributes from scenarioInputs, not a duplicated action list. Observe actual post-call fields and undefined return; encode actual NaN as a disclosed tagged value. Retain passing behavior-preserving variants, wrong rating assignment, wrong indicator comparison and wrong stars assignment with exact failure sets and reference recovery. This evidence qualifies only the four tested source-seam scenarios, not real decorators, parent/mapping implementations, framework rendering, Harmony build/runtime or a formal Agent case. The real automatic verifier repair fixed a missing global without changing the design; it does not establish guidance benefit, automatic knowledge return or cross-repository generalization.
skill.title: The first generated verifier lacked the Observed global and exited before checks. One native-bound automatic repair added an explicit identity decorator and preserved the complete request, design and contract. Independent execution then matched fourteen checks across seven controls plus reference recovery.
